summary: Mobile-only test (375x667) of new free/no-ads disclaimer & consent feature + demo delete regression. All requested flows PASS.

integration_issues.issue: Gate lives only in Home useEffect. Deep link to /duplicates, /large, /ai or /review with fresh storage skips the disclaimer (checked: /duplicates loads without disclaimer). Low impact because the app always opens on /, but it matters for Android intents/deep links.

issues: Home renders for a moment before the async storage check calls router.replace('/disclaimer'), so it flashes. Consider rendering null or a splash until consent has loaded.

action_items: Optional: move the consent check into _layout.tsx (or a guard on every screen) so deep links can't skip it, and avoid the Home flash
critical_code_review_comments: Checkbox inside a Pressable row toggles only once per tap on web (no double toggle). OK.
No ad SDKs in package.json or code. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Consent key disclaimer_accepted_v1 is stored in localStorage as 'true'. Set it before tests to skip the disclaimer, or clear localStorage to simulate first launch. Demo dup select-all + delete = 7 files / 106 MB.
